entities.summary: Desmond Kelly Ridder is an American professional football quarterback for the Green Bay Packers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Cincinnati Bearcats, earning AAC Offensive Player of the Year honors twice before being selected by the Atlanta Falcons in the third round of the 2022 NFL draft.
